title: 第十一章 唯一的办法求追读哇第十二章 金风玉露一相逢感谢叫我火车王的盟主
lines: 经过短暂交流之后，俩难兄难弟已经勉强搞清了情况，接受了彼此的崭新人设。
每天除了抠脚摸鱼就是刷短视频划水的懒汉大兄弟真的是在中土烂泥坑里爬出来的空降精锐，杀人不眨眼的特种兵王；而每天梦里都在卷人考证的小老弟不声不响的忽然之间变成了超能力者，能跟电话讲话——这么一看，小小的大陆汽修店能凑齐这卧龙雏凤兄弟俩，真是风水宝地。
“就是她？”
陆锋最后整理着弹药，确认道。
“对，至少是个带头的。”
季觉点头：“小心一些，这帮家伙已经不是人了。”
“我知道。”
陆锋点头，填装着霰弹枪的子弹，慢条斯理。
就算一开始不知道，杀了几个之后，也知道了。
“这种鬼东西，我在中土见多了，什么乱七八糟的玩意儿，海防炮一炮下去，死的照样干干脆脆。”
陆锋最后拉动枪栓，忽然问：
“怕不怕？”
“怕啊。”
季觉不假思索的点头，反问：“怕就有用么？”
“怕的话，等会儿你先出去，在车里等我。
万一我失手了的话，还有跑路的机会。”
陆锋回头看了他一眼：“这帮鬼东西有权有势，不除掉他们，咱们恐怕在崖城一辈子都不得安宁，你明白吧？”
季觉没有回答。
他忽然感觉，从今天早上，不，从昨天下午，当那个变成怪物的老东西骑着三轮车向着自己撞过来的时候，他的人生或许就已经被彻底的改变了。
只是到现在他才忽然发现而已。
红眼，饥渴，异化，兽类，血，内脏，还有那些不知道是人是鬼的东西……一旦他们被盯上，就永无宁日！
如果不搬开这些绊脚石，自己就没有未来！
但既然有机会的话……
短暂的恍然中，季觉抬头看着陆锋，隔着面具，两人眼瞳中所浮现的，竟然是仿佛照镜子一般的平静和了然：
——必须，把他们都杀了！
可是不对……
季觉嘴唇微动，犹豫了一下。
有那么一瞬间，在他心里一直有個声音不断响起，却不知是‘良知’还是‘软弱’。
它鼓动着，告诉自己：不可以这样，季觉，不要冲动，冷静一些，光杀人解决不了问题……
你至少还得再放一把火！
机械会说话，会告诉自己真相，那么，尸体也可能会有话对别人讲，灵魂呢？真的有吗？会变成鬼吗？会阴魂不散吗？
保险起见的话，把他们全部杀掉，灵质用手表抽干，尸体烧成焦炭，挫骨扬灰，冲进下水道里去，放一把火，烧掉现场，驱散人群之后，在利用煤气把这个该死的夜店炸上天，最后把一路过来所有的监控全都洗掉，他和锋哥找个地方喝顿酒，闹点乱子，最好去警局或者哪个社团门口的监控下面改个时间，留个不在场证明，这样才能安心的回家睡大觉，才谈得上有明天。
可不论选哪条路做什么选择，都只有一个先决条件。
那些鬼东西，全部，都得，死！
“里面有十四个人，旁边小房间里有四个。
门口一个，车里有一个，后车厢里还有一个。”
季觉说：“其中门口左边，那个女人，她旁边的，车里的，都是怪物。
打心脏没用，脑袋爆掉可能还会挣扎，搞的定吗？”
“有点麻烦，可以努力一下。”
面具之下，陆锋咧嘴，像是沦落为观赏宠物的野兽重新磨砺爪牙一样，伸手翻检着包里的装备，告诉他：“等一下，帮我拉闸。”
“什么时候？”
季觉伸手，按在旁边下面的插座上。
陆锋将一具有些年头的夜视仪扣在了脸上，仔细调整着松紧，戴好，开始倒数：“5、4、3、2……”
content_en:
After a brief exchange, the two brothers had managed to figure out the situation and accepted each other's new personalities.
The big lazy brother who spends his days doing nothing but watching short videos is really an airborne elite who crawled out of the muddy pits of Middle-earth and is a special forces king who kills people without batting an eyelid; while the little brother who spends his days dreaming about being involved in people's examinations suddenly turned into a person with super powers and can talk on the phone - from this point of view, it is really a geomantic treasure that a small mainland auto repair shop can gather these two brothers.
"That's her?"
Lu Feng finally sorted out the ammunition and confirmed.
"Yes, at least he's the one taking the lead."
Ji Jue nodded: "Be careful, these guys are no longer human."
"I know."
Lu Feng nodded and loaded the shotgun slowly.
Even if you don't know it at first, you will know it after killing a few.
"I've seen a lot of this kind of ghost thing in Middle-earth. It's a mess. It can be shot down by a coastal defense cannon and it will die just as easily."
Lu Feng finally pulled the bolt of the gun and suddenly asked:
"Are you afraid?"
"Afraid."
Ji Jue nodded without thinking and asked, "Is it useful to be afraid?"
“If you’re afraid, you can go out later and wait for me in the car.
If I miss, I still have a chance to run away. "
Lu Feng turned back and glanced at him: "These ghosts are powerful. If we don't get rid of them, we may not have peace in Yacheng for the rest of our lives. Do you understand?"
Ji Jue didn't answer.
He suddenly felt that since this morning, no, since yesterday afternoon, when the old man who turned into a monster rode a tricycle and hit him, his life might have been completely changed.
It was only now that he suddenly discovered it.
Red eyes, hunger, alienation, beasts, blood, internal organs, and things that don’t know whether they are humans or ghosts... Once they are targeted, there will never be peace!
If you don't remove these stumbling blocks, you will have no future!
But if there is a chance...
In a brief moment of confusion, Ji Jue looked up at Lu Feng. Through the masks, what appeared in their eyes was as calm and clear as if they were looking in a mirror:
——Must kill them all!
But that's not right...
Ji Jue's lips moved slightly and he hesitated.
For a moment, a voice kept ringing in his heart, but he didn't know whether it was 'conscience' or 'weakness'.
It stirred and told itself: You can't do this, Ji Jue, don't be impulsive, be calm, killing people alone won't solve the problem...
You have to at least set another fire!
Machines can talk and tell themselves the truth, so the corpse may also have words to tell others, but what about the soul? Really? Will he become a ghost? Will it linger?
To be on the safe side, kill them all, drain the ectoplasm with a watch, burn the corpses into charcoal, crush the bones and scatter the ashes, rush them into the sewer, set a fire, burn the scene, disperse the crowd, use gas to blow up this damn nightclub, and finally blow it up. All the surveillance cameras on the way were washed away. He and Brother Feng found a place to have a drink and cause some trouble. It would be best to go to the police station or the surveillance camera at the entrance of a club to change the time and leave an alibi. This way, they could go home and sleep peacefully, and talk about tomorrow.
But no matter which path you choose, there is only one prerequisite.
Those ghosts, all of them, must die!
“There were fourteen people inside and four in the small room next to them.
One at the door, one in the car, and another in the back compartment. "
Ji Jue said: "The woman on the left side of the door, the people next to her, and the people in the car are all monsters.
It's useless to hit the heart. If your head explodes, you may still struggle. Can you handle it? "
"It's a bit troublesome, you can try harder."
Under the mask, Lu Feng grinned, like a beast that had been reduced to a pet to re-sharpen its claws. He reached out to check the equipment in his bag and told him: "Wait a minute, help me pull the switch."
"When?"
Ji Jue stretched out his hand and pressed it on the socket below.
Lu Feng fastened an old night vision device on his face, carefully adjusted the tightness, put it on, and started counting down: "5, 4, 3, 2..."
title_en: Chapter 11: The only way is to read Chapter 12: Jin Feng Yu Lu thanks the leader who called me Leeroy when we met
